docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY SINGH, DUC T. AS TO DEFENDANT CHAUDHARY, VINOT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-25-2008 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED FEB-22-2008, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT CHAUDHARY, VINOT
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-25-2008 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SINGH, DUC T. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHAUDHARY, VINOT $496.03 PRINCIPAL, $125.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $621.03, THE COURT DETERMINES PLAINTIFF'S DAMAGES TO BE $ 1,018.85 FOR MEDICAL EXPENSES; $750.00 GENERAL DAMAGES FOR PAIN AND SUFFERING; AND $1,538 FOR PROPERTY LOSS. THE COURT ATTRIBUTES 85% COMPARATIVE NEGLIGENCE TO PLAINTIFF; THE JUDGMENT IS A NET AWARD. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT CHAUDHARY, VINOT
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED JUN-02-2008 ORDERED DESTROYED
